text:
Maria Chen: Posted the postmortem for yesterday's model-registry + auth cascade: https://redwood/internal/postmortems/1969992222 — need owners & clear timelines for follow-ups. TL;DR: auth provider token expiry + model registry fallback misconfig caused a chain failure.

Lucas Patel: I can own model-registry mitigations (fallback registry + retry logic). Will break into checklist.

Maria Chen: Thanks Lucas. Prefer 2w for code + config changes, 1w infra runway. Can you split into concrete tasks with PR/merge ETA?

Lucas Patel: Draft tasks:
- add read-only fallback registry + circuit-breaker
- increase retry backoff + jitter
- emit "empty-model" soft-fail metric and alert
I will push an initial PR by Mon 03/02 and aim to ship by 03/09. :calendar:

Jin Park: I'll own auth mitigations: token refresh monitoring, shorter TTL fallback tokens, and vendor retry behavior. ETA: alerts in 1w, flow rework in 2w. Need vendor API keys for dry-run.

Elaine Gomez: I'll own runbook updates and run a tabletop for the new flows. Can someone add SRE + product to the invite?

Sam O'Neill: @ops-bot please create tracker items for runbook update + tabletop and tag oncall rotation.

ops-bot: Created INC-4873 - "Runbook update + tabletop for model-registry/auth cascade". Owner: Elaine Gomez. Due: 2026-03-09. Link: https://tasks.redwood/INC-4873 :white_check_mark:

Katie Ruiz: We should add a monthly external-SLA audit (check auth provider rotation policies + registry availability SLAs). I'll slot this in the infra roadmap.

Maria Chen: Collating action owners/timelines for the postmortem doc:
- Model registry (Lucas) — PR by 1969995888, deploy by 1969999488
- Auth provider (Jin) — Alerts by 1969995888, refresh-flow plan by 1969999488
- Runbook + tabletop (Elaine) — tabletop invite & materials by 1969993400
- Recurring SLA audit (Katie) — add to roadmap by EOW
Please confirm or flag blockers.

Lucas Patel: Confirm. No blockers besides review bandwidth.

Jin Park: Confirm but blocker: need vendor API keys and a test tenant. @Maria can you coordinate with the vendor CSM?

Maria Chen: On it — pinged vendor CSM and CSE, copying the vendor support ticket. Will update here when keys/tenant are available.

Sam O'Neill: Also adding postmortem tags: cloud-auth, model-registry, vendor-sla. We should update the escalation chain in the doc (add direct CSM contact + account rep).

Elaine Gomez: Tabletop invite sent to #eng + #eng-sre for Mon 03/02 10:00. Materials in the postmortem doc. :spiral_calendar_pad:

Lucas Patel: FYI pushed initial PR draft: https://git.redwood/repo/123/compare — needs review from @jin @elaine.

Maria Chen: Perfect. Let's reconvene in this thread in 3 days for a short status update. If anyone hits a blocker before then, ping #eng-oncall or mention me directly. :eyes:
